# Responders and Non-responders

## 1. Methods

Data was evaluated with fastqc and determined to have nextera
transposase adapter contamination. Data was run through Nephele's QC
pipeline for adapter trimming. Trimmed data was
passed through WGSA2 pipeline in Nephele where it was decontaminated for human reads. 
Read abundances were used in this analysis. 

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(phyloseq)
library(metagMisc)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)

## 2. Data processing 

### Import data and create phyloseq object. 


```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025-LKedit.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)
metadata$Duration.Darkened.Stool<-as.numeric(metadata$Duration.Darkened.Stool)
metadata$Hours.for.stool.sample<-as.numeric(metadata$Hours.for.stool.sample)
metadata$Days.for.stool.sample<-as.numeric(metadata$Days.for.stool.sample)




```

```{r}

data<-read.csv("rarefied_bacterial_table_not_batch_filtered_prev.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)

taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU")]
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU","ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL

otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))
meta<-sample_data(metadata)
dada2_rare_0<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)
```


### Calculating species alpha diversity

```{r}


phy_alphadiv <- estimate_richness(dada2_rare_0)

otu_table <- otu_table(t(dada2_rare_0))
evenness<- diversity(otu_table)/log(specnumber(otu_table))
chao1 <- t(estimateR(otu_table))[,2]
all_alphadivs <- data.frame(phy_alphadiv, evenness, chao1)
update_sample_data <- merge(sample_data(dada2_rare_0), all_alphadivs, by=0)
rownames(update_sample_data) <- update_sample_data$Row.names
update_sample_data$Row.names <- NULL
sample_data(dada2_rare_0) <- update_sample_data
metadata<-update_sample_data


rarefied<-phyloseq_to_df(dada2_rare_0, addtax=F)
rownames(rarefied)<-rarefied[,1]
rarefied<-dplyr::select(rarefied, -c("OTU"))

genus<-tax_glom(dada2_rare_0, "genus")

```

### PERMANOVA 

```{r}

day2_phylo<-subset_samples(dada2_rare_0, Timepoint == "Day 2")

day2_metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(day2_phylo))
```

#### Motility and Darkened Stool

```{r}
adonis2(phyloseq::distance(day2_phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(day2_phylo)$Day2_obs, by="margin")

adonis2(phyloseq::distance(day2_phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(day2_phylo)$Darkened.Stool+sample_data(day2_phylo)$Day2_obs, by="terms")
```

#### Ethnicity 


```{r}

response<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(day2_phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(day2_phylo)$Day2_obs, by="margin")

response<-response[1,c(3,4,5)]
response$Comparison<-"Response"

con<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(day2_phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(day2_phylo)$Day2_obs+sample_data(day2_phylo)$Ethnicity, by="margin")

int<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(day2_phylo, method="bray") ~ sample_data(day2_phylo)$Day2_obs*sample_data(day2_phylo)$Ethnicity, by="terms")


con<-con[1,c(3,4,5)]
int<-int[3,c(3,4,5)]
con$Comparison<-"Effect"
int$Comparison<-"Interaction"
result<-rbind(response, con, int)

rownames(result)<-result$Comparison

kable(result[,c(1,2,3)], caption="Table X. Potential effect and interaction of response and ethnicity.") %>% kable_styling(position="left") %>% scroll_box(width="500px")

```

## 3. Common taxa between response

### Responders


```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results=FALSE}

responder<-subset_samples(genus, Day2_obs == "Responder")
responder_df<-phyloseq_to_df(responder, addtax=T)
rownames(responder_df)<-responder_df[,"genus"]
responder_df[,c("OTU","kingdom","phylum","order","family","class","species","genus","OTU.1")]<-NULL
responder_df<-as.data.frame(t(responder_df))

res_metadata<-metadata %>% filter(Day2_obs=="Responder")


subject_all = Maaslin2(
  input_data = responder_df,
  input_metadata = res_metadata, 
  output = "Timepoint_DAA_LM_res_genus",
  fixed_effects = c('Timepoint'), normalization="NONE", reference=c("Timepoint,Day 0"), random_effect=c("SubjectID", "SequenceRun"), analysis_method="LM", transform="LOG", plot_scatter = FALSE)

LM<-subject_all$results


## re-install maaslin2 to fix package error. Log transform with linear model? 

table<-as.data.frame(LM[,c("feature","value","coef","qval","N.not.zero")])

table_sub<- table %>% filter(qval < 0.20)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_sub4_day0<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)

table_day2<- table_sub4_day0 %>% filter(value=="Day 2")
table_day8<- table_sub4_day0 %>% filter(value=="Day 8")
table_day14<- table_sub4_day0 %>% filter(value=="Day 14")
table_day28<- table_sub4_day0 %>% filter(value=="Day 28")

day8_14<-merge.data.frame(table_day8, table_day14, by="feature", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)
day_8_14_28<-merge.data.frame(day8_14, table_day28, by="feature", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)

day2_day8<-merge.data.frame(table_day2, table_day8, by="feature", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)

day2_day14<-merge.data.frame(table_day2, table_day14, by="feature", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)

day2_day28<-merge.data.frame(table_day2, table_day28, by="feature", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)


day2_day8_day14<-merge.data.frame(day2_day8, table_day14, by="feature", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)

day2_day8_day14_day28<-merge.data.frame(day2_day8_day14, table_day28, by="feature", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)

### Non-responders

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results=FALSE}

non<-subset_samples(genus, Day2_obs == "Non-responder")

```{r}

features<-data.frame(both$feature)
features$genus<-features$both.feature

final<-merge.data.frame(features, all_day2, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)

genus_df$genus<-rownames(genus_df)

merged<-merge.data.frame(genus_df, final, by="genus", all.x=FALSE, all.y=TRUE)

rownames(merged)<-merged[,1]
merged[,1]<-NULL
merged2<-merged[,1:124]
merged2<-as.data.frame(t(merged2))
merged2$Sample<-rownames(merged2)

merged<-merge.data.frame(merged2, metadata, by="Sample", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)

merged3<-merged %>% filter(Day2_obs == "Responder")
merged4<-merged %>% filter(Day2_obs == "Non-responder")

merged5<-rbind(merged3, merged4)

rownames(merged5) <- merged5[,1]
genes<-merged5[,2:19]
gene_names<-colnames(genes)

names(final)[6]<-"p.adj"
final<-data.frame(final)
final$group<-final$feature

final$group1<-final$value
final$group2<-"Day 0"

### Plotting taxa from both groups

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

max_values <- list()

# Loop through each gene name
for (gene in gene_names) { 
  max_values[[gene]]<- max(merged[[gene]], na.rm = TRUE)  # Calculate max and handle NAs if any
}

max_values_df <- data.frame(
  gene = names(max_values),
  max_value = unlist(max_values)
)

max_values_df$max_values_add<-max_values_df$max_value
max_values_df$y.position<-log(max_values_df$max_values_add)*0.45
max_values_df$ymax<-(max_values_df$max_value*10) + max_values_df$max_value

max_values_df$group<-max_values_df$gene  
all_DAA_max<-merge.data.frame(max_values_df, final, by="group", all.x=TRUE, all.y=TRUE)
all_DAA_max$y.position<-as.numeric(all_DAA_max$y.position)
all_DAA_max$p.adj<-round(all_DAA_max$p.adj, digits=3)
all_DAA_max$bracket1<-all_DAA_max$y.position*0.1
all_DAA_max$bracket2<-all_DAA_max$y.position*0.4
all_DAA_max$bracket3<-all_DAA_max$y.position*0.6
all_DAA_max$bracket4<-all_DAA_max$y.position*0.8

all_DAA_max$species<-all_DAA_max$group

split_data <- split(all_DAA_max, f = all_DAA_max$group)

plots2<-list()

```


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

for (i in gene_names) { 

plot<-ggplot(merged5, aes_string(x="Timepoint", y=i))+geom_violin()+geom_point(position =  position_jitter(width = 0.3, height=0, seed=1), size=3, aes(color=Day2_obs))+theme_bw() + ylab(i) + xlab(NULL) +theme(plot.margin = margin(c(20,10,20,10), 'cm'), axis.title.x=element_blank(), axis.text.x=element_text(size=15, angle=45, hjust=1), axis.text.y=element_text(size=15),  axis.title.y=element_text(size=15), plot.title = element_text(size=14), legend.title=element_text(size=20), legend.text=element_text(size=20)) + ggtitle(i)+labs(x=NULL, y="Abundance") +stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="crossbar", size=0.5, color="black")  + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(NA, split_data[[i]]$ymax), trans="log10")+scale_x_discrete(limits=c("Baseline","Day 0", "Day 2","Day 8","Day 14","Day 28"))+scale_colour_manual(values = c("#6baed6","#006d2c"))


plot2<-plot + stat_pvalue_manual(split_data[[i]][1,], label = "q={p.adj}", xmin = "group1", xmax = 'group2', ymax='ymax', bracket.nudge.y = 'bracket1')

plots2[[i]] <- plot2

}

## 4. Changes over time in responders 

### Day 8

```{r}

table_sub<- table_day8 %>% filter(qval < 0.05)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_day8<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)

taxa[,c("species","OTU")]<-NULL
taxa_uniq<-data.frame(unique(taxa))
table_day8$genus<-table_day8$feature
DAA_taxa<-merge.data.frame(table_day8, taxa_uniq, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)


```

```{r}

DAA_taxa$phylum<- factor(DAA_taxa$phylum,
    levels = c('Acidobacteriota','Actinomycetota','Bacillota','Candidatus_Thermoplasmatota','Planctomycetota','Pseudomonadota'), ordered = TRUE)



```

```{r}

mycolors <- c("#deebf7","#A6CEE3", "#2D82AF", "#006d2c", "#FE982C", "#D9A295")

DAA_taxa<- DAA_taxa %>% mutate(updated_text = gsub("_", " ", genus))



DAA_taxa$updated_text<- factor(DAA_taxa$updated_text, levels = DAA_taxa$updated_text[order(DAA_taxa$phylum, DAA_taxa$coef, decreasing=TRUE)])

stacked_species<-ggplot(DAA_taxa, aes(x = coef, y = updated_text, fill=phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",show.legend = TRUE) + xlab("Effect size") +scale_fill_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_classic()+geom_col(color="black")+theme(legend.position="right") +ylab(NULL)+guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 10))+scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-3,3))


#stacked_species
#ggexport(stacked_species, filename="Stacked_plot_species.pdf", width=6, height=9)

DAA_taxa$qval_adj<-(-log10(DAA_taxa$qval))

bubble_species<-ggplot(DAA_taxa, aes(x=value, y=updated_text, size = qval_adj)) + geom_point(alpha=1, aes(color=phylum))+scale_size(range=c(0.01,4), "Significance")+scale_color_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_void()+guides(color="none", fill="none")

#bubble_species
```

<br><br>


```{r fig.cap="**Figure X. Differentially abundant genera (effect size > 1 or <  - 1) colored by phylum 8 days (day 2) after compared to day before (day 0) BSS administration. Significance represents -log of adjusted p value after multiple comparisons (< 0.05). The greater the circle the more statistically significant.**", fig.height=4, fig.width=8}

figure_day8<-stacked_species+bubble_species

figure_day8

FigureSX<-figure_day8

library(downloadthis)
figure_day8 %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Stacked_plot_bacterial_genera",
    output_extension = ".pdf",
    button_label = "Download figure as .pdf",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa-solid fa-image",
    ggsave_args = list(height=4, width=8)
  )



#ggexport(stacked_species+bubble_species, filename="Stacked_plot_genus_w_qval_day8.pdf",width=8, height=3.5)



```
